Hi Olivia,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today — good conversation. This note captures the call highlights, the constraints you emphasized, and a short decision framework we discussed so your team can share internally.

Top takeaways (pain / drivers)
- Data residency: all PHI and related logs must remain in the EU (Ireland) and any backups must be stored in a customer-controlled repository.
- Air-gap / operational isolation: procurement is evaluating a fully isolated deployment (no public egress) for high-sensitivity workloads; there may be a limited subset of non-sensitive workloads that can live in a peered VPC.
- Network constraints: strict inbound firewall rules (only specific IP ranges/peers allowed), no outbound internet except to approved support endpoints; long-lived peering preferred over transient VPNs.
- Compliance asks: audit logs (retention 7 years), key management via BYOK/KMS/HSM, and proof points for SOC 2 and TLS 1.3 across all control plane traffic.
- Timeline: target internal decision by end of Q4; pilot aligned to early Q1 2028.

Decision framework we discussed (high level)
1) Residency requirement satisfied? If yes -> evaluate Private/VPC deployment.
2) If air-gap required -> on-prem or fully isolated VPC with no public egress and offline model bundle option.
3) If limited internet allowed -> Dedicated with strict peering and egress controls + KMS integration.

Immediate asks from your side
- Network diagram showing your edge/DMZ and egress chokepoints (you mentioned a current DMZ appliance on-prem).
- Who owns keys (KMS/HSM) and whether you'll require Redwood to integrate a customer HSM.
- Procurement timeline and any required security artifacts (SLA exceptions, export controls).

Next steps (owners)
- Olivia: share network diagram + primary procurement contact by Thu 16 Sep.
- Ben: draft minimal port/egress list and a recommended peering pattern (sending today).
- Marcus: prepare a short decision matrix mapping risks vs deployment options (will share by Fri).

I'll attach the focused checklist Ben referenced and the template decision matrix for your architects. Happy to set a technical deep-dive next week if useful.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi

Hi Olivia — following up with the concrete network/ports write-up we discussed. Attachment: redwood-vpc-connector-ports.csv (small stub list). Below are the key points; please share this with your network/security team.

High-level connectivity options we support (in order of isolation):
A) On-prem isolated installation (air-gap): offline model bundle, local runtime, optional ops image install. No external egress required; support via staged patch bundles and selectable metrics push to your audit collector.
B) Private VPC (customer-managed peering): VPC peering or PrivateLink; control plane connectivity limited to management CIDRs you provide; TLS 1.3 enforced.
C) Dedicated (managed infra): peered VPC with restricted egress through approved NGFW and customer KMS integration.

Minimal egress/whitelist (for B and C)
- TCP 443 outbound to: support.redwood.io (for control plane), metrics.redwood.io (optional, can be replaced with customer collector).
- NTP to pool.ntp.org (optional if your environment provides time).
- (Optional) Package repo endpoints if you run updates (we can provide offline bundles).

Ports and protocols (examples)
- 443 TCP outbound (control plane / TLS 1.3)
- 5671/5672 (AMQP) only for optional messaging bridges — disabled by default
- 22 TCP (SSH) — available only during pre-approved maintenance windows and via jump host; we recommend just-in-time access with ephemeral keys

BYOK/HSM
- Short answer: yes, we support customer-managed KMS and HSM integrations for key wrapping (command-and-control operations). For a fully air-gapped on-prem install we'll provide an offline key-initialization flow; for VPC/Dedicated we can integrate with your cloud KMS or an HSM-backed key store.

Audit + retention
- Native logs: configurable to push to your SIEM/Log Collector; retention policy can be exported to your storage (S3/GCS compatible) for long-term archiving.
- We can generate an audit artifact package on demand for compliance evidence (weekly or on-request).
